title: Information Games: Strategic Crowding and Firm Repositioning in Language-Model Space
abstract: arXiv:2609.37820v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Firms follow changing economic opportunities, but rivalry changes their response. We develop ESCAPE, a rational-share game of distribution-valued positioning with heterogeneous capability costs, establish a unique equilibrium, and derive an exact reallocation restriction separating opportunity and crowding contributions. Competition need not push firms apart: rational firms can enter increasingly crowded regions, because the full reallocation gain can be positive even when its crowding component is negative. Rivalry instead changes how differently firms respond to the same opportunity shift. In the benchmark many-firm economy, the relative-response component accounts for 90.5% of the weighted squared composition-response contrast between strategic and independent firms; it is numerically zero under identical capabilities. The contrast remains distinguishable under corpus-scale measurement. Corporate news distributions document persiste

translated_title: 信息博弈：语言模型空间中的战略拥挤与企业重新定位
translated_abstract: 企业会追随不断变化的经济机会，但竞争会改变它们的反应方式。我们提出了ESCAPE，一个具有异质性能力成本的、以分布为定位载体的理性份额博弈，建立了唯一均衡，并推导出一个精确的再配置约束，将机会贡献与拥挤贡献分离开来。竞争未必会把企业推向彼此分散：理性企业可能进入日益拥挤的区域，因为即使其拥挤分量为负，完整的再配置收益仍可能为正。相反，竞争改变的是企业对同一机会变化所做出反应的差异程度。在基准的多企业经济中，相对反应分量解释了战略型企业与独立型企业之间加权平方构成反应对比的90.5%；而在企业能力完全相同时，该分量在数值上为零。在语料库规模的测量下，这种对比依然可以分辨。企业新闻分布记录了持续存在的……
tldr: 本文提出具有唯一均衡的ESCAPE理性份额博弈模型，证明竞争并非使企业分散，而是改变它们对同一机会变化的反应差异，相对反应分量解释了战略型与独立型企业之间90.5%的反应对比。
en_tdlr: This paper develops ESCAPE, a rational-share game with a unique equilibrium, showing that competition does not push firms apart but instead changes how differently they respond to the same opportunity shift, with the relative-response component accounting for 90.5% of the strategic-versus-independent response contrast.
